tokens.name: AAVE
tokens.description: AAVE is the native token of Aave, the largest lending protocol in DeFi.
tokens.infoDescription: Aave is an Open Source Protocol to create Non-Custodial Liquidity Markets to earn interest on supplying and borrowing assets with a variable interest rate.

tokens.name: AERO
tokens.description: AERO is the native token of the Aerodrome protocol, a ve(3,3) MetaDex on Base with largely immutable contracts and programmatic value flows to veAERO holders.
tokens.infoDescription: Aerodrome is a decentralized exchange where you can execute low-fee swaps, deposit tokens to earn rewards, and actively participate in the onchain economy.

tokens.name: CRV
tokens.description: CRV is the native token of the Curve protocol - a leading stablecoin DEX. The veCRV gauge system enables programmatic, onchain value direction by tokenholders.
tokens.infoDescription: Curve is a decentralized exchange (DEX) and automated market maker (AMM) on Ethereum and EVM-compatible sidechains/L2s, designed for the efficient trading of stablecoins and volatile assets.

tokens.name: ETHFI
tokens.description: ETHFI is the governance token of ether.fi, a protocol that has expanded from liquid staking into a broader neobank product suite. The protocol is in Phase 0 of a multi-stage decentralisation roadmap. Governance operates through offchain voting with multisig execution. A 4-of-7 multisig controls the Upgrade Timelock (72h delay), which owns the RoleRegistry and authorizes protocol upgrades. Buyback program distributes fees to sETHFI stakers via a Foundation-controlled wallet.
tokens.infoDescription: ether.fi is a liquid restaking protocol that enables users to stake ETH while maintaining liquidity through eETH tokens and participating in EigenLayer restaking.

tokens.name: LDO
tokens.description: LDO is the native token of Lido, a liquid staking protocol with onchain voting, safeguarded by stETH holders via Dual Governance.
tokens.infoDescription: Lido is the leading liquid staking solution for Ethereum.

tokens.name: UNI
tokens.description: UNI is the governance token of the Uniswap DAO, the DAO governing the Uniswap protocol - the largest decentralised exchange in DeFi.
tokens.infoDescription: Uniswap is the largest onchain marketplace. Buy and sell crypto on Ethereum and 16+ other chains.
